name: Payment Instruction 50
definition: Characteristics that apply to the credit side of the payment transactions included in the direct debit initiation.

PaymentInformationIdentification.name: Payment Information Identification
PaymentInformationIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by a sending party, to unambiguously identify the payment information group within the message.

PaymentMethod.name: Payment Method
PaymentMethod.definition: Specifies the means of payment that will be used to move the amount of money.

BatchBooking.name: Batch Booking
BatchBooking.definition: Identifies whether a single entry per individual transaction or a batch entry for the sum of the amounts of all transactions within the group of a message is requested.|Usage: Batch booking is used to request and not order a possible batch booking.

NumberOfTransactions.name: Number Of Transactions
NumberOfTransactions.definition: Number of individual transactions contained in the payment information group.

ControlSum.name: Control Sum
ControlSum.definition: Total of all individual amounts included in the group, irrespective of currencies.

PaymentTypeInformation.name: Payment Type Information
PaymentTypeInformation.definition: Set of elements used to further specify the type of transaction.

RequestedCollectionDate.name: Requested Collection Date
RequestedCollectionDate.definition: Date and time at which the creditor requests that the amount of money is to be collected from the debtor.

Creditor.name: Creditor
Creditor.definition: Party to which an amount of money is due.

CreditorAccount.name: Creditor Account
CreditorAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the creditor to which a credit entry will be posted as a result of the payment transaction.

CreditorAgent.name: Creditor Agent
CreditorAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing an account for the creditor.

CreditorAgentAccount.name: Creditor Agent Account
CreditorAgentAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the creditor agent at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

UltimateCreditor.name: Ultimate Creditor
UltimateCreditor.definition: Ultimate party to which an amount of money is due.

ChargeBearer.name: Charge Bearer
ChargeBearer.definition: Specifies which party/parties will bear the charges associated with the processing of the payment transaction.

ChargesAccount.name: Charges Account
ChargesAccount.definition: Account used to process charges associated with a transaction.||Usage: Charges account should be used when charges have to be booked to an account different from the account identified in debtor's account.

ChargesAccountAgent.name: Charges Account Agent
ChargesAccountAgent.definition: Agent that services a charges account.||Usage: Charges account agent should only be used when the charges account agent is different from the creditor agent.

CreditorSchemeIdentification.name: Creditor Scheme Identification
CreditorSchemeIdentification.definition: Credit party that signs the mandate.

DirectDebitTransactionInformation.name: Direct Debit Transaction Information
DirectDebitTransactionInformation.definition: Provides information on the individual transaction(s) included in the message.

ChargeBearerRule.definition: If ChargeBearer is present, then DirectDebitTransactionInformation/ChargeBearer is not allowed. If DirectDebitTransactionInformation/ChargeBearer is present, then ChargeBearer is not allowed. DirectDebitTransactionInformation/ChargeBearer and ChargeBearer may both be absent.

UltimateCreditorGuideline.definition: UltimateCreditor may only be present if different from Creditor.

ChargesAccountRule.definition: If ChargesAccountAgent is present, then ChargesAccount must be present.

PaymentTypeInformationRule.definition: If PaymentTypeInformation is present, then DirectDebitTransactionInformation/PaymentTypeInformation is not allowed.

CreditorSchemeIdentificationRule.definition: If CreditorSchemeIdentification is present, then DirectDebitTransactionInformation/CreditorSchemeIdentification is not allowed. If DirectDebitTransactionInformation/CreditorSchemeIdentification is present, then CreditorSchemeIdentification is not allowed. DirectDebitTransactionInformation/CreditorSchemeIdentification and CreditorSchemeIdentification may both be absent.

UltimateCreditorRule.definition: If UltimateCreditor is present, then DirectDebitTransactionInformation/UltimateCreditor is not allowed. If DirectDebitTransactionInformation/UltimateCreditor is present, then UltimateCreditor is not allowed. DirectDebitTransactionInformation/UltimateCreditor and UltimateCreditor may both be absent.

ChargesAccountAgentRule.definition: If ChargesAccountAgent is present, then it must contain a branch of the CreditorAgent. It must not contain a completely different agent.
